Taj Mahal sunrise tour from Delhi

Delhi · Agra · Sunrise · 1 day

1 day Taj Mahal tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

A 3 am start from Delhi puts you at the Taj Mahal for first light, the thinnest crowds and the softest photographs — and back in Delhi by mid-afternoon.

At a glance

Duration
About 11 hours
Departure
Delhi, Noida or Gurgaon
Transport
Private AC car
Tour type
Private
Pickup
3 am, hotel or airport
Return
Around 3 pm

What makes this one worth it

  • Inside the Taj Mahal at sunrise, before the crowds
  • Up to three hours at the Taj with a licensed guide
  • Breakfast at a five-star hotel in Agra
  • Agra Fort, with the optional Baby Taj after
  • Back in Delhi by about 3 pm

Your tour schedule

  1. 3:00 AM

    Pickup in Delhi

    Your driver collects you from your hotel in Delhi, Noida or Gurgaon and takes the empty expressway to Agra — about three hours.

  2. 6:00 AM

    The Taj Mahal at sunrise

    Meet your guide and go in with the first visitors of the day. Up to three hours for the history, the architecture and the best photo spots while the marble changes colour.

  3. 9:00 AM

    Breakfast at a five-star hotel

    Breakfast in Agra, with Indian and continental choices.

  4. 10:00 AM

    Agra Fort

    A guided tour of the 16th-century red sandstone fort — its palaces, its courtyards and its views of the Taj across the river.

  5. 11:00 AM

    The Baby Taj, if time allows

    An optional stop at Itimad-ud-Daulah for its marble inlay and symmetrical garden.

  6. 12:00 PM

    Back to Delhi

    The drive back to Delhi, with drop-off at your hotel or chosen address at around 3 pm.

Questions people ask

Is this a private tour?
Yes, fully private. You have your own AC car, driver and licensed English-speaking guide for the whole day, with no other travellers joining.
Is the Taj Mahal open for sunrise visits?
Yes, the gates open shortly before sunrise, which is one of the most beautiful times to see it. We pick you up in Delhi NCR around 3 am to reach Agra in time; the Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays, so sunrise tours run on the other six days.
Are entrance tickets included?
Yes. Sunrise-slot Taj Mahal ticket are included in the price, and your guide handles them at each gate so you skip the ticket queue.
What should I carry?
Your passport or photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, sunglasses and a camera. Keep bags small, as large bags are not allowed inside the Taj Mahal complex.
What is the cancellation policy?
Cancel more than seven days before travel for a full refund of the deposit; closer to the date, costs already committed with hotels and transport are deducted. Our terms page has the details.
What should I wear for the Taj Mahal visit?
Comfortable clothes and good walking shoes. Modest dress that covers shoulders and knees is respectful, and a light layer helps on cool winter mornings.
Is the tour wheelchair accessible?
The Taj Mahal is largely wheelchair accessible, though a few spots have steps or uneven paths where some help is needed. Tell us in advance and your guide will plan the route and assist.
